title: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Instruments and Sender Gauges

content.description: Flowchart for troubleshooting speedometer displaying 0 while driving. The flowchart starts with checking if trip meter operates, then branches based on Yes/No answers through various diagnostic steps including checking cables, voltage readings, and ultimately leads to replacing either the speed sensor or speedometer.
labels: Does trip meter operate with meter disconnected and cable turned?
1) With the ignition S/W at ON position, check that there is 4.0 — 6.0V between terminals 1 and 3 of connector for speed sensor (total counter).
2) With the ignition S/W at ON position, does voltage between terminals 1 and 2 of speed sensor connector fluctuate between 0 — 5.0V when meter cable is turned? 4.0 — 6.0V .......... 0 — 1V
3) With the ignition S/W at ON position, and speed sensor disconnected, does display appear when terminals 1 and 2 of speedometer are connected and disconnected?
4) With the ignition S/W at ON position, check that there is 4.0 — 6.0V between terminals 1 and 3 of speedometer with connector removed.
